description: Royal Jordanian Air Force Lockheed C-130 Hercules donated by the air force and deliberately scuttled off Aqaba as a dive attraction and artificial reef, sitting upright at 15 to 17 m about 300 m offshore in the Aqaba Marine Park, near the sunken tank formation. Arab Divers gives the sinking as 16 November 2017; Divernet dates it to November 2018. No serial has been published anywhere; spottingmode shows RJAF C-130E 354 construction number 3739 deleted from Amman-Marka in the same era but no source links the two, so no tail number is asserted.
